evidence_quotes.section1_missing_quid_pro_quo: Rep never says 'this will take 10–15 minutes' or 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' or waits for a yes before proceeding; jumps straight to confirming the pickup address.
evidence_quotes.section2_missing_their_agenda: Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' — moves directly into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.section3_logistics_full: Property type (apartment, 800 sq ft, 1BR), floor (3rd floor, stair access), rooms (no additional), walking distance (20–30 ft from parking to stairs, 10 ft to door), special considerations (weaving looms with care instructions, washer/dryer), additional stops (1340 Coordination Way, Flueger, house with garage), and destination (2400 sq ft 2-story house) all covered.
evidence_quotes.section3_box_count_asked: Jeline: 'normally for a one bedroom apartment we see fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' and follows up on overflow: 'do you have a large collection that could possibly put you out of that range like dish collection, book collections'
evidence_quotes.section3_packing_not_offered: Rep never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: Jeline: 'normally for a one bedroom apartment, we finish the move-in. Three and a half hours. However, in your case, we're coming from a third floor with stair access only... I've estimate this to finish in five hours to six hours with two movers and one truck estimated cost for this move is $1,040 to $1,248.' — range given and personalized to stair access, fragile items, multiple stops.
evidence_quotes.section4_pricing_framing: Jeline: 'No hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassemble fees... we do have a minimum of two and a half hour. So after that minimum, the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.' and 'everything is included to that gas and truck taxes, insurance. All the wraps and pads to protect the items'
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair_not_asked: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' — customer volunteers concern ('that seems like that seems like a very long estimate') but rep responds to objection rather than offering open silence after a direct ask.
evidence_quotes.section5_two_promises_none: Rep never mentions On-Time Guarantee (discount if late) or No Worries Damage Coverage ($2,000 coverage, no deductible).
evidence_quotes.section5_closes_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' — moves directly to the ask.
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns_throwaway: Jeline: 'do you have any questions before I let you go' — this is the empty 'any questions?' rather than 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.section6_catchall_not_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask_with_out: Jeline: 'So with that, correct, would you like to be on the schedule for October 22nd? No deposit is required.' — the ask is present but immediately followed by 'No deposit is required,' which softens the ask into an implicit out; customer responds 'I'm still getting some prices so I will reach back out to you' and rep accepts without re-engaging.
evidence_quotes.section7_rate_lock_not_mentioned: Rep mentions 'No deposit is required' but never mentions the rate holds or lock-in terms.
evidence_quotes.section7_booking_partial: Date (October 22nd) and crew size (two movers) confirmed, but no phone number confirmation, arrival window, or specific notes left for crew about care of weaving looms despite customer's stated concern ('don't throw it around').

top_strength: Jeline gathered exceptionally thorough logistics details—property type, floor/stair access, distances, special items with care instructions, multiple stops, and even obtained a picture of the weaving looms—all documented accurately to support the estimate.
coaching_note: Never skip Section 2's Their Agenda ('What are your biggest concerns about this move?') and Section 5's Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage)—these are load-bearing commitments that differentiate Einstein; the rep jumped straight to logistics and bypassed both, leaving the customer without the two core promises before asking for the business.
